source_name: Modelica Standard Library — explicit equation-section statements

official_access.access_mode: Acquire an official tagged Modelica Standard Library release or exact Git commit outside GitHub Actions. Prefer the release archive/tag, pin the resolved commit, verify the acquired bytes, and build a deterministic SHA-256 inventory rather than scraping rendered documentation.

scope.corpus: The Modelica/ package tree from an exact Modelica Standard Library release/commit, spanning multi-domain physical and engineering models
structures: if-equation branch leaves with preserved control context
when-equation branch leaves with preserved control context
for-equation leaves with preserved loop context
reinit/assert/terminate and other explicit equation-section calls
scope.original_representation: exact lexical Modelica equation statement from a source .mo file, with enclosing equation-section and branch/loop context retained separately
scope.batching: one exact MSL release/commit plus deterministic Modelica/**/*.mo inventory per extraction/materialization batch
exclusions: Do not treat algorithm-section := assignments as equations in this lane
Do not harvest equation-looking text from comments, strings, HTML documentation or annotations
Do not flatten models, solve equations, expand connect semantics or symbolically rewrite source equations in the extracted stage
Do not treat declaration/binding/modification equations as covered by this first lane; add them only with a separate tested extraction contract

snapshot_policy.rule: Resolve the chosen official MSL release/tag to an exact commit, acquire the release outside GitHub Actions, verify the checkout/archive, inventory LICENSE plus the production Modelica/**/*.mo tree with SHA-256, and use modelica-msl:git:<commit>:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. Any changed commit, file set or byte inventory creates a new immutable snapshot/item.

license_policy.rule: The Modelica Standard Library repository is distributed under the 3-Clause BSD License. Preserve the exact pinned LICENSE in the source inventory and include source/release/commit provenance in published derivatives. Fail closed if the selected release contains an object with a conflicting object-level rights notice rather than assuming repository-level rights override it.

adapter.input: the Modelica/ directory from an exact Modelica Standard Library checkout
validation: comments and strings are masked without changing source offsets, preventing documentation/examples from being emitted
expression_original is the exact lexical equation leaf from source through its terminating semicolon
initial-vs-normal equation section, Modelica class context, file path, line range and enclosing if/when/for branch context are retained
source_record_sha256 is independent of executor checkout directory and depends on snapshot, repository path, source bytes, source offsets and exact expression bytes
snapshot commit must match the separately supplied pinned commit
No OCR, flattening, symbolic rewrite or reconstructed equation is performed at extracted stage
